scope: every .lean file in the repository; apedp_dyn/lean_formal is the layer that verification claims refer to
verdict: Only the 'checked' files are machine-checked from Lean's foundations; an axiom_injected file proves its statement from an assumed axiom, which is a recording of intent, not a proof. No result in this repository may be described as formally verified on the strength of a non-'checked' file.
